capabilities: parse code files with tree-sitter to extract imports, calls, inherits, implements, uses-type, and contains edges
extract typed edges from @see, @tested-by, @adr, and @depends-on comment tags and frontmatter related-code fields
render an interactive force-directed graph with color modes, node sizing, and hover spotlight
highlight TODO/FIXME files, dead code, and community-detected module boundaries
seed domain, status, and author headers across a codebase with one command
extras: Desktop only (tree-sitter WASM workload not validated on mobile). main.js is ~5.8 MB, exceeding Obsidian Sync Standard's 5 MB file cap; the README suggests Sync Plus or another sync method. Ships GitHub artifact attestations for verifying release files; local-first with no network requests.
problem: Obsidian's graph view only maps links between notes, so relationships between code files in the vault stay invisible.

relations.evidence: works with any agent that supports the skills.sh format — Claude Code, Cursor, OpenCode

summary: Code graph plugin that parses source files with tree-sitter and renders imports, calls, inheritance, and documentation-tag relationships as an interactive force-directed graph.
